name: Alchemix USD
oneLiner: alUSD is Alchemix's self-repaying CDP stablecoin: users borrow against DAI/USDC/USDT collateral and the yield from those deposits gradually repays the debt.
collateral: DAI, USDC, and USDT deposited into yield strategies (Yearn, Aave) via Alchemix CDPs; yield automatically repays debt
pegMechanism: Self-repaying loans: yield from deposited stablecoin collateral automatically repays debt; Transmuter guarantees 1:1 redemption

oracleRisk.summary: Alchemix alUSD loans are self-repaying and non-liquidating, so the CDP path does not rely on an external liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Alchemix documents alUSD loans as self-repaying and non-liquidating. A borrower may self-liquidate by repaying debt with collateral, but the protocol does not forcibly liquidate borrower positions, so there is no market-specific oracle and collateral-liquidation branch to enumerate.

sources.label: Ethereum alUSD verified source and ABI

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Arbitrum block 0x1cd87f90, the tracked proxy 0xcb8fa9a76b8e203d8c3797bf438d8fb81ea3326a stored implementation 0x37704b70cba0ffd12eb039274ff46992544a1f16 and ProxyAdmin 0xa44f69aeac480e23c0abfa9a55d99c9f098beac6, whose owner() was 0x7e108711771dfdb10743f016d46d75a9379ca043. At Optimism block 0x9318364, the same proxy address stored implementation 0x29ef9f2fa6f636eafe74e5fba057c7949a37ffa6 and the same ProxyAdmin, whose owner() was 0xc224bf25dcc99236f00843c7d8c4194abe8aa94a. Sourcify exactly verifies both material L2 implementations and the owner-only OpenZeppelin ProxyAdmin. Those owners can replace holder-facing token implementations and introduce per-holder transfer or balance restrictions. The current L2 source has standard transfer paths and only pauses minters; Ethereum's setBlacklist likewise targets a minter rather than an alUSD holder. This is an upgrade-control finding, not an assertion of a live or uniform holder blacklist across every deployment.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 access review

mintAuthority.summary: Ethereum alUSD is minted through the AlchemistV2 CDP under a token ceiling controlled by two ADMIN_ROLE multisigs. The Alchemist proxy is now administered directly by a separate 3-of-7 Safe. Material Optimism xalUSD is minted by a rate-limited LayerZero bridge; its 3-of-7 chain Safe owns both that bridge and the token ProxyAdmin and can replace or raise its limits.

controls.label: AlchemistV2 (CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: AlToken.ceiling(AlchemistV2) is an administrator-set token mint ceiling; Alchemist collateral and LTV checks further constrain user issuance. The contract cannot raise its own ceiling.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, AlToken.ceiling(AlchemistV2) returned 1,000,000,000,000 alUSD and hasMinted returned about 21.94 million alUSD. The proxy still used implementation 0x0f17d856ecc7c8ce9bd7d5b3e52a47eca5e8955a, while its EIP-1967 admin had changed from the previously recorded ProxyAdmin to 3-of-7 Safe 0xf56d660138815fc5d7a06cd0e1630225e788293d. The Alchemist cannot raise its own token ceiling.

controls.label: Alchemix MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock (ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, AlToken ADMIN_ROLE still had exactly two members including this MultiSigWalletWithTimeLock. getOwners() returned seven owners, required() returned 4, and secondsTimeLocked() returned 600 seconds. ADMIN_ROLE can authorize minters and raise their token ceilings but cannot mint directly.

controls.label: Alchemix AlToken ADMIN_ROLE Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, this Safe remained the second of exactly two AlToken ADMIN_ROLE members. Safe API returned the listed 3-of-7 owners, no modules, zero guard and module guard, and Safe 1.3.0. It can authorize minters and raise token ceilings, but the Alchemist proxy-admin role has moved to the separately modeled Safe 0xf56d660138815fc5d7a06cd0e1630225e788293d.

controls.label: Alchemix AlchemistV2 proxy-admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, the AlchemistV2 EIP-1967 admin slot resolved directly to this Safe, replacing the stale ProxyAdmin/owner path recorded previously. Safe API returned a 3-of-7 quorum with no modules and zero guards. It can replace collateral and mint-critical Alchemist logic without an external timelock.

controls.label: Optimism xalUSD LayerZero bridge minter
controls.capDescription: The xalUSD xBridge entry limits this LayerZero bridge to a 1,000,000 alUSD replenishing mint capacity; the bridge cannot change its own allowance.
controls.evidence: At Optimism block 155309063, xBridges(this bridge) returned a 1,000,000 alUSD max mint limit with about 996,936 alUSD currently available. bridge.owner() returned the separately modeled Optimism Safe; token() returned xalUSD and endpoint() returned the canonical LayerZero V2 endpoint.

controls.label: Alchemix Optimism xalUSD admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Optimism block 155309063, this Safe remained owner of both the LayerZero bridge minter and ProxyAdmin 0xa44f69aeac480e23c0abfa9a55d99c9f098beac6; the xalUSD proxy retained implementation 0x29ef9f2fa6f636eafe74e5fba057c7949a37ffa6. Safe API returned 3-of-7 owners, no modules, and zero guards. It can raise bridge limits or replace xalUSD mint logic.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712278, AlToken ADMIN_ROLE still had the 4-of-7 ten-minute multisig and 3-of-7 Safe as its only members, while AlchemistV2 remained cap-limited by the token ceiling. Correction: the Alchemist proxy admin is now the separate 3-of-7 Safe 0xf56d660138815fc5d7a06cd0e1630225e788293d, not the stale ProxyAdmin path. At Optimism block 155309063, the material xalUSD route retained a 1,000,000 alUSD replenishing LayerZero bridge limit; its 3-of-7 Safe owns the bridge and token ProxyAdmin and can raise or replace those constraints. Aggregate cap semantics are raiseable; reconciliation is on-chain/not applicable and no prudential supervisor applies.
review.reviewer: Claude Phase 0c continuation; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

routes.reviewNote: OP-xalUSD is the CrossChainCanonicalAlchemicTokenV2 UUPS proxy (impl 0x29ef9f2fa6f636eafe74e5fba057c7949a37ffa6). Its xBridges() registry has exactly one whitelisted minter: 0xd64ab29cc101e421ee3f4b0eaa721925395ddc05 with a 1M mint/burn cap — an 11,213-byte LayerZero OApp bridge (endpoint() = canonical LZ V2 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c, token() = this xalUSD) whose owner() is the Alchemix Optimism 3-of-7 Safe 0xc224bf25dcc99236f00843c7d8c4194abe8aa94a. This matches Alchemix's May 2026 migration of alUSD/alETH bridging to a v3-compatible LayerZero bridge. xBridges() reads 2026-07-20.

routes.reviewNote: Fantom alUSD (impl 0x211c74db951c161c5a379363716ebdca5125ef59, totalSupply $170.5k) grants minter role 0xdf8b4c520ffe…ec42 to the Alchemix 3-of-7 Safe 0x6b291cf19370a14bbb4491b01091e1e29335e605 AND to the code-less EOA 0x13c716188c38ce27b9b2b672a59543cf1170eabe (RoleGranted block 36896627, hasRole still true 2026-07-20) — the Multichain-era MPC minter whose keys and liveness cannot be established after Multichain's 2023 collapse. The route model cannot honestly encode this EOA as a contract controller, so it stays unresolved.

reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 25530459, the Ethereum AlchemistV2 expectedValue for every registered yield token was aggregated by its on-chain underlying token. The resulting controller-local mix was 80.2263% DAI, 15.9306% USDC, 0.3867% USDT, and 3.4564% FRAX, rounded to one decimal while preserving a 100% total. Each observed slice maps to its exact tracked stablecoin dependency. Re-read 2026-08-08: Alchemix docs still describe L2 xalUSD as backed by Ethereum-collateral; no issuer-published fresher Ethereum Alchemist composition or asset-wide reconciliation was found, so the prior on-chain snapshot remains the latest usable primary-source breakdown and the review is retained as selected-slice evidence rather than an asset-wide composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ethereum AlchemistV2 getSupportedYieldTokens() and getYieldTokenParameters().expectedValue aggregated by underlying token at Ethereum block 25530459
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All registered yield-token expected values in the observed Ethereum Alchemist were attributed to their on-chain underlying stablecoins; asset-wide L2, bridge, Transmuter, and AMO exposure remains unreconciled outside this selected slice.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is deposited non-custodially into AlchemistV2 and routed into registered Yearn/Aave yield strategies, so custody is contract-based rather than with a legal custodian; legal segregation and insolvency treatment do not apply at the protocol layer, and underlying stablecoin issuers retain their own custody and freeze postures.
